simple-value.expression: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TIPO = 'Corrente' THEN SALDOREAL2 ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOCORRENTE, SUM(CASE WHEN TIPO = 'Aplicação' THEN SALDOREAL2 ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOAPLIC, SUM(CASE WHEN TIPO = 'Espécie' THEN SALDOREAL2 ELSE 0 END) AS SALDOESP FROM ( SELECT CTA.CODEMP, (SELECT RAZAOABREV FROM TSIEMP E WHERE E.CODEMP = CTA.CODEMP) AS RAZAOABREV, CASE WHEN CLASSE = 'A' THEN 'Aplicação' WHEN CLASSE = 'D' THEN 'Adiantamento' WHEN CLASSE = 'C' THEN 'Corrente' WHEN CLASSE = 'X' THEN 'Espécie' WHEN CLASSE = 'G' THEN 'Garantida' WHEN CLASSE = 'E' THEN 'Empréstimo' WHEN CLASSE = 'O' THEN 'Outras' ELSE 'Corrente' END AS TIPO, CTA.CODCTABCO, CTA.DESCRICAO, CTA.CODCTABCOINT, SBC.REFERENCIA, (NVL(SBC.SALDOREAL,0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(T7.VLRLANC * T7.RECDESP) FROM TGFMBC T7 WHERE T7.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T7.DTLANC >= to_date( '01/'||to_char(:DAT1, 'mm/yyyy') , 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.DTLANC < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy')),0)) AS SALDOREAL2, (NVL(SBC.SALDOBCO,0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(T7.VLRLANC * T7.RECDESP) FROM TGFMBC T7 WHERE T7.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T7.DHCONCILIACAO >= to_date( '01/'||to_char(:DAT1, 'mm/yyyy') , 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.DHCONCILIACAO < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.CONCILIADO = 'S'),0)) AS SALDOBCO2, CTA.CODCTACTB FROM TGFSBC SBC, TSICTA CTA WHERE CTA.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND CTA.ATIVA='S' AND SBC.REFERENCIA = (SELECT MAX(REFERENCIA) FROM TGFSBC T2 WHERE T2.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T2.REFERENCIA < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy')) AND SBC.CODCTABCOINT = CTA.CODCTABCOINT ORDER BY 2, 4)

FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE60, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE90, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 121 AND 150 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE150, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - SUM(T7.VLRLANC * T7.RECDESP) FROM TGFMBC T7 WHERE T7.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T7.DTLANC >= to_date( '01/'||to_char(:DAT1, 'mm/yyyy') , 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.DTLANC < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy')),0)) AS SALDOREAL2, (NVL(SBC.SALDOBCO,0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(T7.VLRLANC * T7.RECDESP) FROM TGFMBC T7 WHERE T7.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T7.DHCONCILIACAO >= WHERE CTA.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND CTA.ATIVA='S' AND CTA.CODCTABCOINT NOT IN (30) AND SBC.REFERENCIA = (SELECT MAX(REFERENCIA) FROM TGFSBC T2 WHERE T2.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T2.REFERENCIA < chart.expression: SELECT TIPO, CASE WHEN SUM(SALDOREAL2) <0 THEN SUM(SALDOREAL2) *-1 ELSE SUM(SALDOREAL2) END AS SALDOREAL FROM ( SELECT CTA.CODEMP, (SELECT RAZAOABREV FROM TSIEMP E WHERE E.CODEMP = CTA.CODEMP) AS RAZAOABREV, CASE WHEN CLASSE = 'A' THEN 'Aplicação' WHEN CLASSE = 'D' THEN 'Adiantamento' WHEN CLASSE = 'C' THEN 'Corrente' WHEN CLASSE = 'X' THEN 'Espécie' WHEN CLASSE = 'G' THEN 'Garantida' WHEN CLASSE = 'E' THEN 'Empréstimo' WHEN CLASSE = 'O' THEN 'Outras' ELSE 'Corrente' END AS TIPO, CTA.CODCTABCO, CTA.DESCRICAO, CTA.CODCTABCOINT, SBC.REFERENCIA, (NVL(SBC.SALDOREAL,0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(T7.VLRLANC * T7.RECDESP) FROM TGFMBC T7 WHERE T7.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T7.DTLANC >= to_date( '01/'||to_char(:DAT1, 'mm/yyyy') , 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.DTLANC < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy')),0)) AS SALDOREAL2, (NVL(SBC.SALDOBCO,0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(T7.VLRLANC * T7.RECDESP) FROM TGFMBC T7 WHERE T7.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T7.DHCONCILIACAO >= to_date( '01/'||to_char(:DAT1, 'mm/yyyy') , 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.DHCONCILIACAO < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.CONCILIADO = 'S'),0)) AS SALDOBCO2, CTA.CODCTACTB FROM TGFSBC SBC, TSICTA CTA WHERE CTA.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND CTA.ATIVA='S' AND CTA.CODCTABCOINT NOT IN (30) AND SBC.REFERENCIA = (SELECT MAX(REFERENCIA) FROM TGFSBC T2 WHERE T2.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T2.REFERENCIA < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy')) AND SBC.CODCTABCOINT = CTA.CODCTABCOINT ORDER BY 2, 4) WHERE (TIPO= :TIPO OR :TIPO= '.Todos') GROUP BY TIPO

grid.expression: SELECT CODEMP, RAZAOABREV, TIPO, CODCTABCO, DESCRICAO, CODCTABCOINT, ATIVA, (CASE WHEN TIPO = 'Outras' OR TIPO = 'Adiantamento' THEN NULL ELSE SALDOREAL END) AS SALDOREAL, (CASE WHEN TIPO = 'Outras' OR TIPO = 'Adiantamento' THEN NULL ELSE SALDOBCO END) AS SALDOBCO, (CASE WHEN TIPO <> 'Adiantamento' THEN NULL ELSE SALDOREAL END) AS SALDOADTOS, (CASE WHEN TIPO <>'Outras' THEN NULL ELSE SALDOBCO END) AS SALDOOUTRAS, CODCTACTB FROM ( SELECT CTA.CODEMP, (SELECT INITCAP(NOMEFANTASIA) FROM TSIEMP E WHERE E.CODEMP = CTA.CODEMP) AS RAZAOABREV, CASE WHEN CLASSE = 'A' THEN 'Aplicação' WHEN CLASSE = 'D' THEN 'Adiantamento' WHEN CLASSE = 'C' THEN 'Corrente' WHEN CLASSE = 'X' THEN 'Espécie' WHEN CLASSE = 'G' THEN 'Garantida' WHEN CLASSE = 'E' THEN 'Empréstimo' WHEN CLASSE = 'O' THEN 'Outras' ELSE 'Corrente' END AS TIPO, CTA.CODCTABCO, CTA.DESCRICAO, CTA.CODCTABCOINT, SBC.REFERENCIA, CTA.ATIVA, (NVL(SBC.SALDOREAL,0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(T7.VLRLANC * T7.RECDESP) FROM TGFMBC T7 WHERE T7.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T7.DTLANC >= to_date( '01/'||to_char(:DAT1, 'mm/yyyy') , 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.DTLANC < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy')),0)) AS SALDOREAL, (NVL(SBC.SALDOBCO,0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(T7.VLRLANC * T7.RECDESP) FROM TGFMBC T7 WHERE T7.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T7.DHCONCILIACAO >= to_date( '01/'||to_char(:DAT1, 'mm/yyyy') , 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.DHCONCILIACAO < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy') AND T7.CONCILIADO = 'S'),0)) AS SALDOBCO, CTA.CODCTACTB FROM TGFSBC SBC, TSICTA CTA WHERE CTA.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND CTA.ATIVA='S' AND CTA.CODCTABCOINT NOT IN (30) AND SBC.REFERENCIA = (SELECT MAX(REFERENCIA) FROM TGFSBC T2 WHERE T2.CODCTABCOINT = SBC.CODCTABCOINT AND T2.REFERENCIA < to_char(:DAT1+1,'dd/mm/yyyy')) AND SBC.CODCTABCOINT = CTA.CODCTABCOINT ORDER BY 2, 4) WHERE (ATIVA = 'S' OR (ATIVA='N' AND SALDOREAL<>0)) AND (TIPO = :TIPO OR :TIPO = '.Todos') ORDER BY TIPO, CODCTABCOINT

grid.title: Clientes a Receber - Referência: :DAT1
grid.expression:
SELECT 1 AS ORDEM, D.CODPARC, D.RAZAOSOCIAL, NULLIF(D.VLR,0) AS VLR, NULLIF(D.VLRFIN,0) AS VLRFIN, NULLIF(D.VLRDEVOL,0) AS VLRDEVOL, D.VLRTOTAL, (D.VLRTOTAL / SUM(VLRTOTAL) OVER () )*100 AS REP, CODCTACTB, CTACTB FROM(
SELECT CODPARC, UPPER(RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, SUM(VLR) AS VLR, SUM(VLRFIN) AS VLRFIN, SUM(VLRDEVOL) AS VLRDEVOL, SUM(VALOR) AS VLRTOTAL FROM(
--ORIGEM PORTAL - TIPMOV= "V" SELECT FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, T.TIPMOV, PAR.CODCTACTB, PLA.CTACTB, CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV <> 'D' THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE 0 END AS VLR, 0 AS VLRFIN, CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE 0 END AS VLRDEVOL, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT As VALOR FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB WHERE FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND (CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN FIN.DTNEG ELSE FIN.DTENTSAI END) <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND ((T.TIPMOV IN ('V') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1) OR (T.TIPMOV IN ('D') AND FIN.RECDESP = -1)) AND :OUTROS IN ('A','P')
UNION ALL
--ORIGEM FINANCEIRO - TIPMOV= "I" SELECT FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, T.TIPMOV, PAR.CODCTACTB, PLA.CTACTB, 0 AS VLR, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT AS VLRFIN, 0 AS VLRDESC, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT As VALOR FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB WHERE FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('I') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'N' AND :OUTROS IN ('A','F') ) GROUP BY CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, CODCTACTB, CTACTB )D
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS ORDEM, 0 AS CODPARC, '. TODOS' AS RAZAOSOCIAL, NULL AS VLR,NULL AS VLRFIN, NULL AS VLRDEVOL, NULL AS VLRTOTAL,NULL AS REP, NULL AS CODCTACTB, NULL AS CTACTB FROM DUAL ORDER BY ORDEM,VLRTOTAL DESC, RAZAOSOCIAL

--TITULOS ORIGEM FINANCEIRO - TOP TIPO "I" SELECT CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV <> 'I' THEN 'Portal' ELSE 'Financeiro' END AS ORIGEM, FIN.CODEMP, FIN.DTNEG, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT As VALOR, FIN.DTVENC, FIN.DHBAIXA, FIN.CODTIPTIT||' - '||upper(TIT.DESCRTIPTIT) AS TIPTIT, FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, FIN.CODTIPOPER, FIN.NURENEG, CASE WHEN DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Recebido' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 0 THEN 'A Vencer' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 30 THEN 'Vencido até 30 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 60 THEN 'Vencido até 60 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 90 THEN 'Vencido até 90 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 180 THEN 'Vencido até 180 dias' ELSE 'Vencido mais de 180 dias' END AS CLASSIFICACAO, CASE WHEN DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL THEN 1 WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 0 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS CLASSIF, FIN.HISTORICO, 159 AS CODCTACTB FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB LEFT JOIN TGFTIT TIT ON TIT.CODTIPTIT = FIN.CODTIPTIT WHERE (FIN.CODPARC = :PARCEIRO or :PARCEIRO = 0) AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTNEG <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('I') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'N' AND :OUTROS IN ('A','F') ) WHERE (CLASSIFICACAO = :CLASSIFICACAO OR :CLASSIFICACAO IS NULL) ORDER BY CODPARC, DTVENC, DTNEG

grid.title: Clientes Vencidos

SELECT 1 AS ORDEM, D.CODPARC, D.RAZAOSOCIAL, D.APELIDO, D.VALOR, (D.VALOR / SUM(VALOR) OVER () )*100 AS REP FROM( SELECT CODPARC, UPPER(RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, APELIDO, SUM(VALOR) AS VALOR FROM( --ORIGEM PORTAL - TIPMOV= "V" SELECT FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, VEN.APELIDO, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT As VALOR FROM TGFFIN FIN , TGFPAR PAR , TGFNAT NAT , TGFTOP T, TGFVEN VEN WHERE FIN.CODTIPOPER = T.CODTIPOPER AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND NVL(PAR.CODVEND,0) = NVL(VEN.CODVEND,0) AND FIN.DHTIPOPER = T.DHALTER AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTNEG <= :DAT1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA is null AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('V') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND ((FIN.CODTIPOPER <> 3206 AND :VDAGER = 'S') OR :VDAGER = 'N') AND to_date(SYSDATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') > 0 AND :OUTROS IN ('A','P')

TODOS' AS RAZAOSOCIAL, NULL AS APELIDO, 0 AS VALOR, NULL AS REP FROM DUAL ORDER BY ORDEM, VALOR DESC

TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 90 THEN 3 WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 180 THEN 3 ELSE 3 END AS CLASS, PAR.CODCTACTB2 FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT NUFIN, SUM(VALOR) AS VALOR FROM TGFIMF GROUP BY NUFIN) IMF ON IMF.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN WHERE FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('I') AND FIN.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'N' AND (FIN.CODPARC = :PARCEIRO or :PARCEIRO = 0) AND T.TIPMOV||'-'||NAT.CODNAT NOT IN ('I-301006') AND :OUTROS IN ('A','F') ) WHERE (CLASSIFICACAO = :CLASSIFICACAO OR :CLASSIFICACAO IS NULL) ORDER BY CODPARC, DTVENC

grid.title: Folha e Impostos a Pagar/Recuperar - Referência: :DAT1
grid.expression: SELECT FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, NVL(SUM(FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP),0) AS VALOR FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT , TGFTOP T WHERE FIN.CODTIPOPER = T.CODTIPOPER AND PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.DHTIPOPER = T.DHALTER AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND NVL(FIN.DTENTSAI,FIN.DTNEG) <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'D' AND NAT.CODNAT NOT IN (340002) GROUP BY FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS CODNAT, '. Todos' AS DESCRNAT, 0 AS VALOR FROM DUAL ORDER BY CODNAT

chart.title: Folha e Impostos por Status - Natureza: $P_NATUREZA - Referência: :DAT1
chart.expression: SELECT SUM(ABS(VALOR)) AS VALOR, CLASSIFICACAO, :NATUREZA AS NATUREZA2 FROM( SELECT CASE WHEN DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Pago' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 0 THEN 'A Vencer' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 30 THEN 'Vencido até 30 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 60 THEN 'Vencido até 60 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 90 THEN 'Vencido até 90 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 180 THEN 'Vencido até 180 dias' ELSE 'Vencido mais de 180 dias' END AS CLASSIFICACAO, NVL(SUM(FIN.VLRDESDOB),0) AS VALOR FROM TGFFIN FIN , TGFPAR PAR , TGFNAT NAT , TGFTOP T WHERE FIN.CODTIPOPER = T.CODTIPOPER AND PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.DHTIPOPER = T.DHALTER AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND NVL(FIN.DTENTSAI,FIN.DTNEG) <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'D' AND NAT.CODNAT NOT IN (340002) AND (FIN.CODNAT = :NATUREZA OR :NATUREZA = 0) GROUP BY FIN.DTVENC, FIN.DHBAIXA) GROUP BY CLASSIFICACAO

grid.title: Detalhamento por Título - Natureza: $P_NATUREZA - Referência: :DAT1
grid.expression: SELECT * FROM( SELECT FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, FIN.CODEMP, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.DTNEG, FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) As VALOR, FIN.DTVENC, FIN.DHBAIXA, FIN.CODTIPOPER, FIN.NURENEG, CASE WHEN DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Pago' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 0 THEN 'A Vencer' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 30 THEN 'Vencido até 30 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 60 THEN 'Vencido até 60 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 90 THEN 'Vencido até 90 dias' WHEN to_date(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(FIN.DTVENC,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= 180 THEN 'Vencido até 180 dias' ELSE 'Vencido mais de 180 dias' END AS CLASSIFICACAO, HISTORICO, NAT.CODCTACTB FROM TGFFIN FIN , TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT , TGFTOP T WHERE FIN.CODTIPOPER = T.CODTIPOPER AND PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.DHTIPOPER = T.DHALTER AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND NVL(FIN.DTENTSAI,FIN.DTNEG) <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'D' AND NAT.CODNAT NOT IN (340002) AND (FIN.CODNAT = :NATUREZA or :NATUREZA = 0) ORDER BY FIN.CODPARC, FIN.DTVENC ) WHERE (CLASSIFICACAO = :CLASSIFICACAO OR :CLASSIFICACAO IS NULL)

grid.title: Saldo Devedor por Instituição - Referência: :DAT1 - Empresa(s): :CODEMP
grid.expression:
SELECT CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, SUM(VRCP) AS VRCP, SUM(VRLP) AS VRLP, SUM(VRTOT) AS VRTOT FROM ( SELECT FIN.CODPARC, NVL(PAR.NOMEPARC,PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, CASE WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(DTVENC,:DAT1) <= 12 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB)*FIN.RECDESP ELSE 0 END As VRCP, CASE WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(DTVENC,:DAT1) <= 12 THEN 0 ELSE (FIN.VLRDESDOB)*FIN.RECDESP END As VRLP, FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP AS VRTOT, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, FIN.DTVENC, (FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP) As VALORDESDOB, FIN.CODTIPOPER, FIN.HISTORICO FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT WHERE PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND (NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'E') ) GROUP BY CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS CODPARC, ' .TODOS' AS RAZAOSOCIAL, 0 AS VRCP, 0 AS VRLP, 0 AS VRTOT FROM DUAL
ORDER BY RAZAOSOCIAL

chart.title: Saldo Devedor por Contrato - Referência: :DAT1 - Empresa(s): :CODEMP - Instituição: $P_NOME
chart.expression: SELECT REPLACE(RAZAOSOCIAL,'BANCO ','') AS RAZAOSOCIAL, CODNAT, NUMNOTA, :PARCEIRO AS PARCEIRO2, ABS(SUM(VRCP)) AS VRCP, ABS(SUM(VRLP)) AS VRLP, COUNT(NUFIN) AS QTDE FROM ( SELECT FIN.CODPARC, CASE WHEN FIN.CODNAT = 0902010 THEN PAR.NOMEPARC ELSE PAR.NOMEPARC||' - '||NUMNOTA END AS RAZAOSOCIAL, CASE WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(DTVENC,:DAT1) <= 12 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB)*FIN.RECDESP ELSE 0 END As VRCP, CASE WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(DTVENC,:DAT1) <= 12 THEN 0 ELSE (FIN.VLRDESDOB)*FIN.RECDESP END As VRLP, FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP AS VRTOT, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT AS NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, FIN.DTVENC, (FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP) As VALORDESDOB, FIN.CODTIPOPER, FIN.HISTORICO FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT WHERE PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND (NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'E') AND (FIN.CODPARC = :PARCEIRO OR :PARCEIRO = 0) ) GROUP BY RAZAOSOCIAL, NUMNOTA, CODNAT ORDER BY RAZAOSOCIAL, NUMNOTA

grid.title: Detalhamento por Título - Rerefência: :DAT1 - Empresa(s): :CODEMP - Instituição: $P_NOME
grid.expression: SELECT FIN.CODPARC, NVL(PAR.NOMEPARC,PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, CASE WHEN NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ= 'E' THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP ELSE NULL END As VALOR, FIN.DTVENC, FIN.DHBAIXA, CASE WHEN DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Pago' WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(DTVENC),TO_CHAR(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY')) <= 12 THEN 'Vencidos ou a Vencer até 12 meses' ELSE 'Vencimento maior que 12 meses' END As "Prazo_CP_ou_LP", FIN.CODTIPOPER, FIN.HISTORICO, PAR.CODCTACTB3 AS CTBCP, PAR.CODCTACTB4 AS CTBLP FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT WHERE PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND (NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'E') AND (FIN.CODPARC= :PARCEIRO OR :PARCEIRO = 0) AND (FIN.CODNAT = :CODNAT OR :CODNAT IS NULL) ORDER BY CODPARC, DTVENC, DTENTSAI, NUMNOTA, FIN.CODNAT DESC

grid.title: Posição por Vencimento
grid.expression: SELECT ANOMES, MESANO, SUM(VRTOT) AS VRTOT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') AS ANOMES, TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'MM/YYYY') AS MESANO, FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP AS VRTOT FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT WHERE PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND (NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'E') AND (FIN.CODPARC= :PARCEIRO OR :PARCEIRO = 0) AND (FIN.CODNAT = :CODNAT OR :CODNAT IS NULL) ) GROUP BY ANOMES,MESANO ORDER BY ANOMES

grid.title: Parcelamentos por Processo - Referência: :DAT1
grid.expression:
SELECT CODNAT, DESCRNAT, SUM(VRCP) AS VRCP, SUM(VRLP) AS VRLP, SUM(VRTOT) AS VRTOT FROM ( SELECT FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, CASE WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(DTVENC,:DAT1) <= 12 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB + FIN.VLRJURO)*FIN.RECDESP ELSE 0 END As VRCP, CASE WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(DTVENC,:DAT1) <= 12 THEN 0 ELSE (FIN.VLRDESDOB + FIN.VLRJURO)*FIN.RECDESP END As VRLP, FIN.DTENTSAI As "DtOperacao", FIN.NUMNOTA As "Nro_Nota", FIN.DTVENC As "DtVencto", (FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP) As "Vlr_Amortizacao", (FIN.VLRJURO*FIN.RECDESP) As "Vlr_Juros", ((FIN.VLRDESDOB + FIN.VLRJURO)*FIN.RECDESP) As "VRTOT", FIN.CODTIPOPER As "Top", FIN.HISTORICO As "Historico", FIN.NUFIN As Nufin FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT WHERE PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND NAT.CODNATPAI= 040500 ) GROUP BY CODNAT, DESCRNAT
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS CODNAT, ' .Todos' AS DESCRNAT, 0 AS VRCP, 0 AS VRLP, 0 AS VRTOT FROM DUAL
ORDER BY CODNAT

grid.title: Parcelamentos por Processo - Referência: :DAT1 - Selecionado: $P_NATUREZA
grid.expression:
SELECT NUMNOTA,DTENTSAI, COUNT(NUFIN) AS QTDE, SUM(VRCP) AS VRCP, SUM(VRLP) AS VRLP, SUM(VRTOT) AS VRTOT, :NATUREZA AS NATUREZA2 FROM ( SELECT FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, CASE WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(DTVENC,:DAT1) <= 12 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB + FIN.VLRJURO)*FIN.RECDESP ELSE 0 END As VRCP, CASE WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(DTVENC,:DAT1) <= 12 THEN 0 ELSE (FIN.VLRDESDOB + FIN.VLRJURO)*FIN.RECDESP END As VRLP, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.NUMNOTA As "Nro_Nota", FIN.DTVENC As "DtVencto", (FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP) As "Vlr_Amortizacao", (FIN.VLRJURO*FIN.RECDESP) As "Vlr_Juros", ((FIN.VLRDESDOB + FIN.VLRJURO)*FIN.RECDESP) As "VRTOT", FIN.CODTIPOPER As "Top", FIN.HISTORICO As "Historico", FIN.NUFIN As Nufin FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT WHERE PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND NAT.CODNATPAI= 040500 AND (NAT.CODNAT = :NATUREZA OR :NATUREZA = 0)
) GROUP BY NUMNOTA, DTENTSAI
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS NUMNOTA, TO_DATE('01/01/1900','DD/MM/YYYY') AS DTENTSAI, 0 AS QTDE, 0 AS VRCP, 0 AS VRLP, 0 AS VRTOT, :NATUREZA AS NATUREZA2 FROM DUAL
ORDER BY DTENTSAI, NUMNOTA

grid.title: Detalhamento dos Parcelamentos - Referência: :DAT1 - Selecionado: $P_NATUREZA - Processo: $P_PROCESSO
grid.expression: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.CODPARC ||' - '||PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL AS "PARCEIRO", FIN.NUFIN, FIN.NUMNOTA, (FIN.VLRDESDOB*FIN.RECDESP) As "VLRDESDOB", FIN.DTVENC, FIN.DHBAIXA, FIN.HISTORICO, CASE WHEN DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Pago' WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(DTVENC),TO_CHAR(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY')) < 0 THEN 'Vencido' WHEN MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(DTVENC),TO_CHAR(:DAT1,'DD/MM/YYYY')) <= 12 THEN 'A vencer até 12 meses' ELSE 'Vencimento maior que 12 meses' END As "Prazo_CP_ou_LP", FIN.CODNAT||' - '||NAT.DESCRNAT AS "NATUREZA", FIN.CODNAT, NAT.CODCTACTB AS CTACTBCP, NAT.CODCTACTB2 AS CTACTBLP FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT WHERE PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND NAT.CODNATPAI= 040500 AND (FIN.NUMNOTA = :PROCESSO OR :PROCESSO = 0) ) WHERE (CODNAT= :NATUREZA OR :NATUREZA = 0) ORDER BY NATUREZA, DTVENC, DTENTSAI, NUMNOTA, NUFIN

grid.title: Posição por Tipo - Referência: :DAT1
grid.expression: SELECT CODNAT, DESCRNAT, SUM(VALOR) AS TOTAL FROM( SELECT FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT AS DESCRNAT, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) AS VALOR, FIN.DHBAIXA, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, FIN.CODEMP, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.DTNEG, FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, FIN.CODTIPOPER FROM TGFFIN FIN , TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT , TGFTOP T WHERE FIN.CODTIPOPER = T.CODTIPOPER AND PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.DHTIPOPER = T.DHALTER AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTNEG <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('I') AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'A' )GROUP BY CODNAT, DESCRNAT UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS CODNAT, ' .TODOS' AS DESCRNAT, NULL AS TOTAL FROM DUAL ORDER BY CODNAT

grid.title: Posição Adiantamentos - Referência: :DAT1 - Natureza: $P_NATUREZA
grid.expression: SELECT CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, SUM(TOTAL) AS TOTAL, :NATUREZA AS NATUREZA2 FROM( SELECT FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, ((FIN.VLRDESDOB)* FIN.RECDESP) AS TOTAL, FIN.DHBAIXA, FIN.CODEMP, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.DTNEG, FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, FIN.CODTIPOPER FROM TGFFIN FIN , TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT , TGFTOP T WHERE FIN.CODTIPOPER = T.CODTIPOPER AND PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.DHTIPOPER = T.DHALTER AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTNEG <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('I') AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'A' AND (FIN.CODNAT = :NATUREZA or :NATUREZA = 0) )GROUP BY CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS CODPARC, ' .TODOS' AS RAZAOSOCIAL, NULL AS TOTAL, :NATUREZA AS NATUREZA2 FROM DUAL ORDER BY TOTAL DESC

grid.title: Detalhamento por Título - Referência: :DAT1 - Natureza: $P_NATUREZA
grid.expression: SELECT * FROM( SELECT FIN.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, FIN.CODEMP, FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.DTNEG, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) AS VALOR, FIN.DHBAIXA, FIN.CODTIPOPER, FIN.HISTORICO, NAT.CODCTACTB FROM TGFFIN FIN , TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT , TGFTOP T WHERE FIN.CODTIPOPER = T.CODTIPOPER AND PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.DHTIPOPER = T.DHALTER AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('I') AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'A' AND (FIN.CODPARC = :PARCEIRO or :PARCEIRO = 0) AND (FIN.CODNAT = :NATUREZA or :NATUREZA = 0) ORDER BY FIN.CODPARC, FIN.DTVENC ) ORDER BY RAZAOSOCIAL, DTENTSAI, NUMNOTA

grid.title: Auditoria Contábil x Financeira - Referência: :DAT1
grid.expression:
SELECT * FROM(
SELECT TIPO, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, SUM(VLRTOTALFIN) AS VLRTOTALFIN, SUM(VLRTOTALFIN) - SUM(VLRTOTALCTB) AS VLRDIVERGENCIA, SUM(VLRTOTALCTB) AS VLRTOTALCTB, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA FROM(
-- CLIENTES - POSIÇÃO FINANCEIRA SELECT TIPO, CODPARC, UPPER(RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, SUM(VALOR) AS VLRTOTALFIN, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA, 0 AS VLRTOTALCTB FROM(
/*CLIENTES EM ABERTO E DEVOLUÇÕES DE CLIENTES EM ABERTO - INICIO*/ --TITULOS ORIGEM FINANCEIRO - TOP TIPO "V" SELECT CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN 'CLIENTES' WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN 'DEVOL. VENDA' ELSE 'CLIENTES' END AS TIPO, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT As VALOR, CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN PAR.CODCTACTB WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN 197 ELSE PAR.CODCTACTB END AS CODCTACTB, CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN PLA.CTACTB WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN '2.1.01.10.004' ELSE PLA.CTACTB END AS CTACTB, CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN PLA.DESCRCTA WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN 'DEVOL. VENDAS A COMPENSAR' ELSE PLA.CTACTB END AS DESCRCTA FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB LEFT JOIN TGFTIT TIT ON TIT.CODTIPTIT = FIN.CODTIPTIT WHERE FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND (CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN FIN.DTNEG ELSE FIN.DTENTSAI END) <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND ((T.TIPMOV IN ('V') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1) OR (T.TIPMOV IN ('D') AND FIN.RECDESP = -1))
UNION ALL
--TITULOS ORIGEM FINANCEIRO - TOP TIPO "I" SELECT 'CLIENTES' AS TIPO, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT As VALOR, PAR.CODCTACTB AS CODCTACTB, PLA.CTACTB, PLA.DESCRCTA FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB LEFT JOIN TGFTIT TIT ON TIT.CODTIPTIT = FIN.CODTIPTIT WHERE FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTNEG <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('I') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'N' /*CLIENTES EM ABERTO E DEVOLUÇÕES DE CLIENTES EM ABERTO - FIM*/ ) GROUP BY TIPO, CODPARC, UPPER(RAZAOSOCIAL),CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA
UNION ALL
--CLIENTES - POSIÇÃO CONTÁBIL SELECT CASE WHEN CODCTACTB = 197 THEN 'DEVOL. VENDA' ELSE 'CLIENTES' END AS TIPO, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, 0 AS VLRTOTALFIN, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA, SUM(VLRTOTAL) AS VLRTOTALCTB FROM( SELECT PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, LAN.CODCTACTB, PLA.CTACTB, PLA.DESCRCTA, LAN.VLRLANC*DECODE(LAN.TIPLANC,'R',-1,1) AS VLRTOTAL FROM TCBLAN LAN LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = LAN.CODCTACTB LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODCTACTB = PLA.CODCTACTB WHERE LAN.DTMOV <= :DAT1 AND LAN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND (PLA.CODCTACTBPAI = 169 OR LAN.CODCTACTB = 197) ) GROUP BY CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA HAVING SUM(VLRTOTAL) <> 0 ) GROUP BY TIPO, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA HAVING SUM(VLRTOTALFIN) <> SUM(VLRTOTALCTB)

-- FORNECEDORES - POSIÇÃO FINANCEIRA SELECT TIPO, CODPARC, UPPER(RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, SUM(VALOR) AS VLRTOTALFIN, CODCTACTB AS CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA, 0 AS VLRTOTALCTB FROM( /*FORNECEDORES EM ABERTO E DEVOLUÇÕES DE FORNECEDORES EM ABERTO - INICIO*/ --TITULOS ORIGEM PORTAL - TOP TIPO "C"/"E" SELECT CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'C' THEN 'FORNECEDORES' WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'E' THEN 'DEVOL. COMPRA' ELSE 'FORNECEDORES' END AS TIPO, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, NVL(((FIN.VLRDESDOB-NVL(IMF.VALOR,0))*FIN.RECDESP),0) As VALOR, CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'C' THEN PAR.CODCTACTB2 WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'E' THEN 198 ELSE PAR.CODCTACTB2 END AS CODCTACTB, CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'C' THEN PLA.CTACTB WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'E' THEN '1.1.03.10.003' ELSE PLA.CTACTB END AS CTACTB, CASE WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'C' THEN PLA.DESCRCTA WHEN T.TIPMOV = 'E' THEN 'DEVOL. DE COMPRAS A COMPENSAR' ELSE PLA.DESCRCTA END AS DESCRCTA FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB2 LEFT JOIN TGFTIT TIT ON TIT.CODTIPTIT = FIN.CODTIPTIT LEFT JOIN (SELECT NUFIN, SUM(VALOR) AS VALOR FROM TGFIMF GROUP BY NUFIN) IMF ON IMF.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN WHERE FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND ((T.TIPMOV IN ('C') AND FIN.RECDESP = -1) OR (T.TIPMOV IN ('E') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1))
UNION ALL
--TITULOS ORIGEM FINANCEIRO - TOP TIPO "I" SELECT 'FORNECEDORES' AS TIPO, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, NVL(((FIN.VLRDESDOB-NVL(IMF.VALOR,0))*FIN.RECDESP),0) As VALOR, PAR.CODCTACTB2 AS CODCTACTB, PLA.CTACTB AS CTACTB, PLA.DESCRCTA FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB2 LEFT JOIN TGFTIT TIT ON TIT.CODTIPTIT = FIN.CODTIPTIT LEFT JOIN (SELECT NUFIN, SUM(VALOR) AS VALOR FROM TGFIMF GROUP BY NUFIN) IMF ON IMF.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN WHERE FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND FIN.DTENTSAI <= :DAT1 AND (FIN.DHBAIXA > :DAT1 OR FIN.DHBAIXA is null) AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('I') AND FIN.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND NAT.AD_TIPOCTBZ = 'N' AND T.TIPMOV||'-'||NAT.CODNAT NOT IN ('I-301006') /*FORNECEDORES EM ABERTO E DEVOLUÇÕES DE FORNECEDORES EM ABERTO - FIM*/ ) GROUP BY TIPO, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA

COMPRA' ELSE 'FORNECEDORES' END AS TIPO, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, 0 AS VLRTOTALFIN, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA, SUM(VLRTOTAL) AS VLRTOTALCTB FROM( SELECT PAR.CODPARC, UPPER(PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, LAN.CODCTACTB, PLA.CTACTB, PLA.DESCRCTA, LAN.VLRLANC*DECODE(LAN.TIPLANC,'R',-1,1) AS VLRTOTAL FROM TCBLAN LAN LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = LAN.CODCTACTB LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODCTACTB2 = PLA.CODCTACTB WHERE LAN.DTMOV <= :DAT1 AND LAN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND (PLA.CODCTACTBPAI = 194 OR PLA.CODCTACTB = 198) ) GROUP BY CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA HAVING SUM(VLRTOTAL) <> 0 ) GROUP BY TIPO, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, CODCTACTB, CTACTB, DESCRCTA HAVING SUM(VLRTOTALFIN) <> SUM(VLRTOTALCTB)
) ORDER BY 1,5
